title: Next-Gen AI Ethernet (NVIDIA Spectrum-X & Ultra Ethernet UEC): Packet Spraying, OOO Direct Data Placement & CC Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Legacy RoCEv2 (Static 5-Tuple ECMP + Strict In-Order Go-Back-N RNIC + Reactive DCQCN)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern at >1K GPUs: ECMP collisions + strict in-order RNIC limit multi-tenant busbw to 53.6% of line rate

tiers.name: Tier 2: Flowlet Dynamic Load Balancing (DLB Switches at >50us Inter-Packet Gaps + Tuned DCQCN)
tiers.verdict: Good improvement (78.4% eff.), but continuous back-to-back RDMA bursts lack flowlet gaps for re-hashing

tiers.name: Tier 3: Switch Per-Packet Spraying WITHOUT NIC Out-of-Order Direct Data Placement (Triggers GBN Retries!)
tiers.verdict: Fatal Trap: Enabling switch packet spraying when NIC `ooo_rx` is off causes massive Go-Back-N retransmission storms!

tiers.name: Tier 4: AI Ethernet (Spectrum-X / UEC: Adaptive Packet Spraying + SuperNIC OOO Direct Placement + RTT/EQDS CC)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 48.1 GB/s busbw (96.2% line rate in multi-tenant!), 4.2ms tail latency & -81.4% stall TCO
